corrected_row.notes: Photos, maps, transcripts and other non-photocopy media are 'any other record' — fee capped at actual cost with only the § 87(1)(c) components (lowest-paid qualified employee's hourly salary, storage media actual cost, qualifying outside-service cost). The 'different fee otherwise prescribed by statute' saver (which PRECEDES the fee clauses in the current rendering) matters here: several record types (e.g., vital records, court transcripts) carry their own statutory fees outside FOIL.
